unresolved_source_fields: Exact Ti3SiC2 substrate slab thickness and atom coordinates are not provided by the article or checked supplement.
Exact relaxed coordinates and registry fractional translations are not provided; only schematic high-symmetry definitions are given.
The article's interface d0 cannot be unambiguously mapped to the project's explicit mean-plane gap without coordinates.
Actual atom count and numeric atom-ID map cannot be frozen until source coordinates and substrate layer count are known.
The existing 52-atom COD/Kisi candidate is from an already-scored family and its (0.37,0.21) offsets are synthetic; it is not an independent DEV source.
